Esiweni Luxury Safari Lodge
Perched atop a cliff above the Sundays River, Esiweni Luxury Safari Lodge is an intimate five-suite property set in the heart of the Nambiti Private Game Reserve, KwaZulu-Natal, South Africa. Entirely off-grid and powered 100% by solar energy, this malaria-free lodge offers an exclusive Big Five safari experience, combining breathtaking views, authentic wildlife encounters and the French Art de Vivre.
A proud member of Relais & Ch teaux, awarded 2 MICHELIN Guide Keys in 2026, ranked No. 1 among Yonder's best safari lodges in Africa, recognised among the Top 100 Restaurants in South Africa, and named Best Lodge Winner 2018 and Finalist 2023 (H tels & Lodges), Esiweni invites you to experience one of Africa's most exclusive and unforgettable luxury safaris.
.
Find out more
Nambiti Private reserve
Situated in the secluded Nambiti Private Game Reserve, Esiweni Safari Lodge is located in the heart of Zulu country. The region's only Big Five' reserve, Nambiti is also home to more than 40 other animal species including black rhino and cheetahs plus over 280 species of bird. Possessing a rare untouched beauty, the resort is a place of rare biodiversity.
Learn more
Making the most of every moment
A family home dedicated to meeting your requirements, Esiweni Safari Lodge promises totransform each and every day into an unforgettable experience. Dine under the stars, go on safari with an experienced ranger to meet the Big Five, fly over the plains in a hot-air balloon at sunrise or bathe at the foot of a waterfall...welcome to Esiweni.
Discover our experiences
Discover our suites
Esiweni Safari Lodge's 5 suites invite you to explore the wilderness. Built into the side of a cliff, the suites overlook the Sundays River and offer exceptional views of the Nambiti Reserve below.
Find out more
Discover Africa
Do you want to make your African dream come true by extending your stay in South Africa? Esiweni Voyages offers tailor-made itineraries. We'll take you to exceptional destinations so that you can discover the rich diversity of this multi-faceted continent.

Esiweni Lodge - Luxury Suites | 100% Off-Grid, Malaria-Free
X
Languages :
EN
FR
Book your stay
«  I never knew of a morning in Africa when I woke up that I was not happy »
Ernest Hemingway
Hidden away in the middle of Zulu country, this magnificent cliff-top Relais & Ch teaux property overlooks the Sundays River. Elegantly decorated, each of the five independent suites has a panoramic terrace, inviting you to enjoy the breathtaking landscapes below. The Nambiti Reserve alternates between bush and savannah, plains and waterfalls, and is the only reserve in the region with such a high game population.
The Heart of the Lodge
Perched high on a cliff, Le Relais & Ch teaux is a luxurious and exclusive African lodge, 100% off-grid and solar-powered, with accommodation for up to 10 guests in an idyllic setting. Overlooking the savannah, Esiweni Safari Lodge's 5 suites offer breathtaking views. A range of indoor and outdoor living areas including a boma, bar, patio, a beautiful terrace and an infinity pool offer endless opportunities for you to relax and unwind. Everything here is designed to give you a feeling of freedom that is so unique to Africa.
Esiweni Lodge: 100% Off-Grid, Solar-Powered
Nambiti Private Game Reserve, South Africa October 2025
Perched on a cliff in the heart of the Nambiti Private Game Reserve, Esiweni Lodge, member of Relais & Ch teaux, has reached a major milestone: the property is now entirely off-grid, powered 100% by solar energy.
This initiative is fully aligned with the 12 commitments of Relais & Ch teaux, particularly those dedicated to protecting biodiversity, reducing environmental impact, and preserving local heritage and communities.
"Becoming off-grid is more than a technical decision it's a conviction. We live in the middle of the savannah, surrounded by nature in its most powerful and fragile form. It is our duty to protect it while continuing to offer an authentic, refined experience inspired by the French art of living."
Ludovic Caron, Co-Owner of Esiweni Lodge
Restaurant
Creative cuisine, between modernity, tradition and products from African nature.
From breakfast to dinner, gastronomy is an integral part of your days at the lodge. It is sublimated thanks to unexpected flavors. From the Rusk (typical African biscuit) that you snack on before a morning safari, to muesli, to a healthy and light lunch. The restaurant offers local products, cooks with the herbs from the garden, and the meat comes from the butcher's shop on the reserve itself. Amazing and surprising meats on the plate, but entirely organic, local and respectful of the animal. Esiweni teams will be constantly be listening to your desires and preferences or intolerances to make the best out of it.
Our Suites
The lodge's 5 suites are all inspired by Africa's wide-open spaces. Showcasing local craftsmanship, their refined style invites you to indulge in the tranquillity of your surroundings. Each suite is built into the side of a cliff, overlooking the Sundays River and offering spectacular views of the Nambiti reserve.
